create_VideoWriter_instance: create a VideoWriter instance with a custom output path, fps, and cache directory
write_frame_from_numpy: write a numpy array frame to the video with optional resizing
write_frame_from_pil: write a PIL Image frame to the video writer
write_frame_from_matplotlib: write a matplotlib Figure frame to the video writer
get_video_from_frames: generate an MP4 video from written frames using ffmpeg or torchvision
